target: PDT-II targets (1)/(2)/(4): test whether complete/separating operational records can enforce associativity and remove n=7

exact_result.proved_theorem: For any defect map delta:X->W and injective linear record map L:W->Y, L(delta(x))=0 iff delta(x)=0. Separating records provide faithful diagnosis/certification, not a law forcing delta to vanish.
exact_result.falsified_candidate: Unital bilinear positive-norm-composing alternative composition plus a tomographically complete/separating operational record family selects n=3 or enforces associativity.
exact_result.counterexample: The octonions O=R+R^7 with all seven imaginary-coordinate records: the record map is injective on the full associator span while nonzero associators remain.
exact_result.consequence: Record completeness cannot by itself supply PDT-native associative composition or select n=3. A separate physical/compositional law must constrain the defect itself.

dimension_stress.record_map: identity on an n-dimensional defect space
dimension_stress.result: rank=n and nonzero defects remain nonzero records in every tested dimension; detectability does not imply defect absence

prior_art_boundary: Injectivity is elementary linear algebra; octonion alternativity, norm composition and nonassociativity are classical. No novelty is claimed for those ingredients.
open: Derive or falsify a PDT-native law that constrains composition defects themselves, such as independently motivated operational path-independence, coherent composition, or a resource-cost principle strong enough to exclude the octonionic sector without assuming associativity by fiat.
